name: AI Auto Content Publisher Lite
author: miaomiao1

sections.description:
Tired of writing product promotion articles manually? Let AI do the heavy lifting! AI Auto Content Publisher Lite automates your WordPress content creation process.

This lite version works with powerful AI models to generate high-quality, relevant text based on your configuration. It’s an excellent tool for content marketing, especially for the US market and beyond.

Key Features:

  • Dual AI Model Support: Choose the best AI for your needs! Now supports OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini) for global audiences and Tongyi Qwen (通义千问 qwen-max).
  • Instant API Key Validation: No more guessing! Use the “Test Connection” button to instantly verify your API key and model selection are working correctly.
  • Seamless User Experience: Control buttons (Enable, Stop, Run Once) now use AJAX technology for a smooth, no-reload experience.
  • Single Configuration: Simply enter a product link, custom prompt, keywords, and an optional image to get started.
  • Dynamic Keyword Rotation: The plugin randomly picks a keyword from your list for each post, ensuring content diversity.
  • Flexible Post Status: Choose to create posts as Draft, Published, or Pending Review.
  • Advanced Image Handling: Use an image as a Featured Image or automatically insert it at the end of your content.
  • User-Friendly Interface: A clean settings page with a real-time activity log makes management a breeze.

Upgrade to Pro for:
– Multiple AI models (including GPT-4 and DeepSeek)
– Unlimited configurations
– Advanced scheduling
– More…

Pro version: AI Auto Content Publisher for WordPress

External Services

This plugin uses external API services to generate content based on your settings. An API key from the respective service is required.

  • OpenAI API: Used when the OpenAI model is selected. Connects to https://api.openai.com/v1/.
  • Alibaba Cloud DashScope API (Tongyi Qwen): Used when the Tongyi Qwen model is selected. Connects to https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-auto-content-publisher-lite folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AI Content Lite.
  4. Choose your desired AI Model (e.g., OpenAI – GPT-4o-mini).
  5. Enter the corresponding API Key (e.g., your sk-... key for OpenAI) and click the “Test Connection” button to verify it.
  6. Configure your product link, prompt, keywords, image, and publishing rules.
  7. Click “Save All Settings”.
  8. Use the “Enable Daily Auto-Post” button to start the automatic schedule.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • Fix: Corrected a critical bug in the API response handling that caused the “Manual run failed with an unexpected error.” message. The plugin is now fully functional again.
  • Tweak: Minor version bump for the crucial bug fix.

2.1.0

  • New Feature: Added support for multiple AI models! Users can now choose between OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini) and Tongyi Qwen (qwen-max).
  • New Feature: Added an API Key “Test Connection” button for instant validation of the key and model.
  • Improvement: Control buttons (Start, Stop, Run Once Now) now use AJAX for a smoother, no-reload user experience.
  • Improvement: Refactored internal API handling code for better security and maintainability.
  • Compatibility: Tested and confirmed working with WordPress 6.6.

2.0.1

  • Updated AI model from GPT-3.5-Turbo to GPT-4o-mini for faster and better responses.
  • Fixed readme: reduced tags to 5, updated Contributors, shortened short description for WordPress.org.
  • Updated descriptions/changelog to reflect the new AI model.

2.0.0

  • Major change from Tongyi Qwen to OpenAI GPT models.
